experiment_data.hypothesis: DeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned on raw text provides an upper-bound for C4 depth distinguishability compared to 15D LightGBM on handcrafted features. Pairwise AUC should exceed LightGBM at all depth pairs since the model has access to full lexical/semantic signal.

spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache python scripts/run_deberta_c4.py
